caption: The drawing depicts a decorative architectural niche positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The niche has an arched top with a scalloped or curved outline and is bordered by a thick, reddish-brown frame. Flanking the niche on either side are two vertical, column-like supports, also colored in reddish-brown with hints of light blue or grey highlights, each topped with a small blue finial. The interior of the niche features a domed back panel adorned with vertical segments in light green and muted red, creating a striped effect, and the main recessed area shows a marbled pattern with pink, red, and soft grey hues. Along the outer edges of the niche, behind the columns, there are scrolling, wing-like shapes rendered in a soft grey color. The base of the niche is flat, extending slightly outward and integrating with the surrounding structural elements, with a bluish tint on the horizontal surface. The rest of the paper is unadorned, with no other objects present.
title: Shrine for statuette
